summary: Frontend-only testing of the Draft Shelf feature on /songcoder.html. Exercised badge/counter liveness, drawer open/close (Escape), sorted draft rows with correct titles/types/times, Resume + Clear per row, 'Load as new' for a missing song-edit draft (Ghost Song) including the Replace-draft modal, Clear single (arm then clear) with toast, Clear all with confirm modal, empty state, badge disabled state, and mobile 390px layout. All testids present in template render correctly.
action_items: Mock backend (/app/backend/server.py SEED) does not seed content/models.html, so state.models stays empty on a fresh load. This means the 'Model not found' flag on a seeded treesh_mad_model_draft:999 is suppressed (code checks state.models.length > 0). Not a bug in the drafts feature, but prevents end-to-end testing of the missing-model 'Load as new' path through the mock. Consider adding a minimal content/models.html to SEED so this flow is testable without first creating a model in the UI.
critical_code_review_comments: listDrafts in songcoder.html (lines ~3044-3056): correctly guards 'missing' flag only after catalog/models have loaded (prevents false positives before fetch). Logic is sound.

resumeDraft handles both missing-with-existing-new-draft (prompts replace modal) and non-missing with/without ref branches cleanly. Toast fallback for 'Load the catalog/model board first' is user friendly.
clearDraft special-cases active song-edit (exitEdit) and song-new while not editing (resetForm) to keep form state in sync — good.
state.shelfPaint hook in loadCatalog/setModels keeps the open shelf in sync with newly loaded data — verified count updates live.
Single-file constraint respected; drafts code is isolated under the '/* draft shelf */' comment and reuses existing icon/toast/confirmModal helpers (no duplication).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (model-missing path blocked by mock seed, not by code)

test_credentials: GitHub token: any dummy string (e.g. 'github_pat_DUMMY') + apiBase pointed at {REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/mockgh works with the mock.
seed_data_creation: During tests seeded localStorage keys: treesh_songcoder_cfg_v2 (cfg with apiBase=/api/mockgh), treesh_songcoder_draft_v2, treesh_mad_edit_draft:ghostsongnobody, treesh_mad_model_draft:999, treesh_mad_model_draft:new. localStorage cleared between runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The /songcoder.html page requires cfg.apiBase to be set to the mock backend ({REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api/mockgh) before the catalog loads; the Settings UI's 'Save' button does not persist unless Owner/Repo fields are filled (defaults are TreeshWoodz/Treesh). Easiest path in Playwright: preseed treesh_songcoder_cfg_v2 in localStorage then reload. `state` is script-scoped (not on window) so can't be read via page.evaluate — rely on DOM selectors ([data-testid=conn-pill], [data-testid=drafts-count], [data-testid=draft-row], etc.). The mock does NOT seed content/models.html; to exercise the model-missing path, either add it to backend SEED or create a model via the UI first. Previously-missing /app/test_reports/iteration_12.json was not found; this iteration file is iteration_13.json.
